idea-plugin.name: Cert Lifetime Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Finds the renewal settings in your repo that outlive the public TLS cap: 200 days since 15 March 2026, 100 days from 15 March 2027, 47 days from 15 March 2029.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Cert Lifetime Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 16 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/cert-lifetime-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/cert-lifetime-lint

action.text: Cert Lifetime Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run Cert Lifetime Lint on the file in the editor
